title: 49ers' Bosa 'far along' in rehab, eyes camp return...

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: 49ers' Bosa 'far along' in rehab, eyes camp return...
sources.description: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa said he is making progress recovering from a torn ACL and could be back for the start of training camp or soon after, barring any setbacks.
